messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — recurring partial streaming responses and timeout disconnects during 2026-03-28 14:00-15:30 UTC. Pattern: long-generation requests stall (token churn >20s) and the edge proxy issues RST_STREAM/GOAWAY. Need short-term heartbeat & canary plan + SDK resume.

lee: Seen in traces; tail latency aligns with model tokenization stalls. Short mitigation: introduce server heartbeat (HTTP/2 PING) or periodic small chunk flushes. Also add client-side resume + jitter.

sagar: Confirm logs: `2026-03-28T14:11:42Z proxy=envoy event=RST_STREAM reason=idle_timeout req=ef45` — we lack app-level keepalive during long gens.

dev-rel: Product reported ~10% drop in chat completions for some cohorts. We'll need communication template for affected customers if rollout changes affect Dedicated customers.

kevin: Ops can run a per-region canary to bump idle timeout and enable probe keepalives. Need a rollback window and metrics to watch.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5120 "streaming: heartbeat + timeout canary" assigned to ops-oncall. Link: https://tickets/INF-5120

maria: Action items (owners + due):
- A1: Server heartbeat / small-chunk flush (staging test) — owner: sagar — due: 2026-03-31
- A2: Proxy idle-timeout canary (EU then US) — owner: kevin (ops) — due: 2026-03-30
- A3: SDK resume token + exp backoff + randomized jitter — owner: lee — due: 2026-04-04
- A4: Observability: `streaming.partial_chunks`, chunk_interval hist + alerting (per-route) — owner: dev-rel — due: 2026-03-29

maria: I'll create a shared checklist and schedule a 30m sync Friday 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC. Please update the ticket/checklist with progress. Reply here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
